title: Blanket Donation Drive
summary: Volunteers distributed approximately 2,700 blankets across NGOs, government schools, and rural areas.
description: During the harsh winter season, volunteers from Noida and Gurgaon DCs distributed approximately 2,700 blankets across NGOs, government schools, rural areas, and underprivileged localities in the NCR. This large-scale initiative brought comfort to those most in need, and left our teams deeply moved by the experience of giving warmth.
